authority: Owner instruction: assume external researcher-dependent work is impossible and cross it out.
reason: External clinical expert review and real participant collection are unavailable and will not be pursued. Existing source documentation, software controls and private preparation are retained.
evidence_rule: Exclusion does not satisfy the original scientific criterion and must never be counted as completion. Clinical validation and reviewer-benefit claims remain unsupported.
still_in_scope: Official-source research, obtainable data and independent technical preparation. An external dataset does not automatically require recruiting an external researcher; access and eligibility must be assessed separately.
